blocks.text: The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Muskingum County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 5 on Facebook or Twitter for current Muskingum County construction information.

blocks.text: Interstate 70
blocks.textContent: Interstate 70

blocks.text: Reconstruction in Zanesville - This project will reconstruct I-70 though the city of Zanesville, resurface I-70 between U.S. 40 and State Route 93. Full reconstruction will begin west of the Licking Road overpass, including the Maple Avenue ramps and Maple Avenue at the end of the ramps, and end east of the abandoned railroad overpass. The project also impacts 16 bridges in the area. For more project details, visit the project page. Estimated Completion: Fall 2028.

blocks.text: Phase three configuration is now in place. If the contractor must take a lane at overnight, the westbound driving lane will close, and the only access to downtown from I-70 westbound will be U.S. 40 (exit 152) and SR 93 (exit 157).

blocks.text: I-70 westbound passing lane operates like an express lane. This means that once motorists enter the express lane after SR 93 (exit 157), they will be unable to exit until U.S. 40 (exit 152).
